description:
Use this when you need a deterministic Slovakia working-day offset. Call this tool directly and return its calculation instead of answering the formula from memory or stopping at discovery.

Do not use this when pinned Slovakia 2026 statutory rest-day layer over an explicitly declared Monday-Friday planning baseline, not an individual roster. The holidays on May 8 and September 15 are not statutory rest days in 2026; September 1, October 28 and November 17 are state holidays without rest under section 2(3). Do not infer substitute Mondays, payroll premiums, leave rights, retail closures, shift, bank, school, employer or future-year schedules. Later legal changes require a new snapshot.
What it computes: Adds or subtracts Slovakia authority-scope working days in exact coverage. Distinguishes 11 rest-day holidays from five named holidays without statutory rest in 2026.
Example user requests: Add or subtract Slovakia working days around May 8 is a named holiday but a working date. | Add or subtract Slovakia working days around Good Friday. | Add or subtract Slovakia working days around November 17 is not statutory rest.
Inputs: start_date (date); working_days (integer).
Complete JSON argument examples: {"start_date":"2026-01-01","working_days":0}
Outputs: start_date, result_date, working_days_added, calendar_days_elapsed, public_holidays_skipped, territory, territory_name, day_type, holiday_names, holiday_kinds, holiday_details, calendar_scope, holiday_policy, substitute_day_policy, calendar_profile, dataset_version, sources, holiday_rest_status, payroll_scope.
Formula: working = weekday outside the declared weekly rest and outside statutory_rest_holiday dates
Direct REST fallback: POST https://tttkmbb.com/api/v1/calculate/slovakia-public-add-working-days with the same JSON input fields. Do not guess another /api/* path.
Docs: https://tttkmbb.com/everyday/slovakia-public-add-working-days.md

working_days.description: Signed offset; start date excluded for non-zero offsets.

name: add_sk_working_days

outputSchema.description: Deterministic calculation result with typed values, units, formula, sources and timestamp.

day_type.description: weekend_baseline, regular_workday or statutory_rest_holiday; not an individual roster.

holiday_details.description: Structured event details, including partial-day notes where published.

holiday_rest_status.description: Rest classification on result.date; a named holiday alone never implies non-working status.

payroll_scope.description: Always not_computed; calendar semantics do not decide wage premiums or leave.

substitute_day_policy.description: No next-Monday substitution or employer day off is inferred

service_version.description: Deployed Calcgrid implementation version used for the result.

title: Add Slovakia Working Days
